from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError

REVIEW_ONLY_KIND = "review-only"
"""The ``Lane kind:`` of a review-only lane: it reviews a head and leaves no pull request."""

REVIEW_MARKER = "ONEX-AGENT-REVIEW"
"""The line ``ONEX-AGENT-REVIEW head=<40 hex>`` that opens the review in the final message."""

REVIEW_HEAD_PREFIX = "Review head:"
"""The brief's column-zero line naming the exact head the session must review."""

REVIEW_FILE = "/tmp/onex-agent-review.txt"
"""Where the session also writes the review, outside its checkout, so it is never pushed."""

FINAL_TEXT_MAX = 200_000
"""The longest final message the parse reads; a longer one is refused, never cut."""

_SHA = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{40}")
_MARKER_LINE = re.compile(rf"^{REVIEW_MARKER} head=(\S*)[ \t]*$", re.MULTILINE)
_HEAD_LINE = re.compile(rf"{re.escape(REVIEW_HEAD_PREFIX)}[ \t]*(\S*)[ \t]*")
_FENCE = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*(```|~~~)[A-Za-z0-9_-]*[ \t]*$", re.MULTILINE)

SEVERITY_WORDS: dict[str, str] = {
    "C": "critical",
    "M": "major",
    "m": "minor",
    "n": "nit",
}
"""The compact severity letters and the words the voter review carries."""


class EnumCloudReviewRefusal(StrEnum):
    """Why a session's text is not a review the lane may return."""

    NO_TEXT = "no_text"
    TOO_LONG = "too_long"
    NO_MARKER = "no_marker"
    BAD_HEAD = "bad_head"
    HEAD_DIFFERS = "head_differs"
    NO_JSON = "no_json"
    SCHEMA = "schema"
    MORE = "more"


class ModelCompactReviewFinding(BaseModel):
    """One compact finding: ``{"c":"T01","p":"src/x.py","l":42,"s":"M"}``."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid", strict=True)

    c: str = Field(min_length=1)
    p: str = Field(min_length=1)
    line: int = Field(alias="l", ge=0)
    s: Literal["C", "M", "m", "n"]
    y: (
        Literal[
            "architecture",
            "security",
            "performance",
            "correctness",
            "completeness",
            "feasibility",
            "testing",
            "style",
        ]
        | None
    ) = None
    n: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=120)


class ModelCompactReviewVerdict(BaseModel):
    """A complete compact verdict; ``done`` is the terminal marker a cut reply lacks."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid", strict=True)

    v: str = Field(min_length=1)
    f: list[ModelCompactReviewFinding]
    more: bool
    done: Literal[True]


class ModelCloudReviewFinding(BaseModel):
    """One finding in the shape the dispatch node's voter review carries."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    path: str = Field(min_length=1)
    line: int = Field(ge=0)
    severity: str = Field(min_length=1)
    claim: str = ""


class ModelCloudReview(BaseModel):
    """The typed unsigned review read back from one ended session."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    head_sha: str = Field(pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")
    catalog_version: str = Field(min_length=1)
    findings: tuple[ModelCloudReviewFinding, ...] = ()
    source: Literal["final_message", "review_file"]


class ModelCloudReviewRefused(BaseModel):
    """A text that is not a review, and why."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    reason: EnumCloudReviewRefusal
    detail: str = ""


def _column_zero(text: str) -> Iterator[str]:
    """Lines outside fenced blocks, so a quoted example is never read as metadata."""
    fence: str | None = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith(("```", "~~~")):
            marker = stripped[:3]
            fence = marker if fence is None else (None if fence == marker else fence)
            continue
        if fence is None:
            yield line


def review_head(brief: str) -> str | None:
    """The head the brief asks the session to review (its first column-zero ``Review head:`` line), or None."""
    for line in _column_zero(brief):
        found = _HEAD_LINE.fullmatch(line)
        if found:
            head = found.group(1).lower()
            return head if _SHA.fullmatch(head) else None
    return None


def _refused(
    reason: EnumCloudReviewRefusal, detail: str = ""
) -> ModelCloudReviewRefused:
    return ModelCloudReviewRefused(reason=reason, detail=detail)


def parse_cloud_review(
    text: str,
    expected_head: str | None,
    source: Literal["final_message", "review_file"] = "final_message",
) -> ModelCloudReview | ModelCloudReviewRefused:
    """The review the text holds after its last marker line, or the typed reason it holds none.

    Error details name the rule that failed and never echo the reply's text."""
    if not text.strip():
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.NO_TEXT)
    if len(text) > FINAL_TEXT_MAX:
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.TOO_LONG, f"over {FINAL_TEXT_MAX} chars")
    markers = list(_MARKER_LINE.finditer(text))
    if not markers:
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.NO_MARKER, f"no {REVIEW_MARKER} line")
    last = markers[-1]
    head = last.group(1).lower()
    if not _SHA.fullmatch(head):
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.BAD_HEAD, "head is not 40 hex")
    if expected_head is not None and head != expected_head.lower():
        return _refused(
            EnumCloudReviewRefusal.HEAD_DIFFERS, "the review names another head"
        )
    body = _FENCE.sub("", text[last.end() :]).strip()
    try:
        payload, _end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(body)
    except ValueError:
        return _refused(
            EnumCloudReviewRefusal.NO_JSON, "no JSON object after the marker"
        )
    try:
        verdict = ModelCompactReviewVerdict.model_validate(payload)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        fields = sorted(
            {
                ".".join(str(part) for part in err["loc"]) or "<document>"
                for err in exc.errors(include_input=False, include_context=False)
            }
        )
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.SCHEMA, f"fields {fields}")
    if verdict.more:
        return _refused(
            EnumCloudReviewRefusal.MORE, "the reviewer had more findings than it listed"
        )
    return ModelCloudReview(
        head_sha=head,
        catalog_version=verdict.v,
        findings=tuple(
            ModelCloudReviewFinding(
                path=item.p,
                line=item.line,
                severity=SEVERITY_WORDS[item.s],
                claim=" ".join(
                    part for part in (item.c, item.y or "", item.n or "") if part
                ),
            )
            for item in verdict.f
        ),
        source=source,
    )


def read_session_review(
    final_text: str, file_text: str, expected_head: str | None
) -> ModelCloudReview | ModelCloudReviewRefused:
    """The review of the final message, else of the review file; the final message's refusal when neither holds one."""
    first = parse_cloud_review(final_text, expected_head, "final_message")
    if isinstance(first, ModelCloudReview) or not file_text.strip():
        return first
    second = parse_cloud_review(file_text, expected_head, "review_file")
    return second if isinstance(second, ModelCloudReview) else first


__all__ = [
    "FINAL_TEXT_MAX",
    "REVIEW_FILE",
    "REVIEW_HEAD_PREFIX",
    "REVIEW_MARKER",
    "REVIEW_ONLY_KIND",
    "SEVERITY_WORDS",
    "EnumCloudReviewRefusal",
    "ModelCloudReview",
    "ModelCloudReviewFinding",
    "ModelCloudReviewRefused",
    "ModelCompactReviewFinding",
    "ModelCompactReviewVerdict",
    "parse_cloud_review",
    "read_session_review",
    "review_head",
]

```python
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""The savings baseline when the caller named no session model.

``resolve_baseline_model`` takes the session model first. Without one, the
baseline is the configured ``pricing.baseline_model`` (the overlay, then the
store), then the model the developer has used most in the history the caller
passes, and only with none of those the fixed default. The history is a
mapping of model id to use count; a blank id or a count below one is not use.
A tie goes to the lowest model id, so the same history always names the same
baseline.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Literal

__all__ = ["BaselineSelectionCase", "configured_or_most_used"]

#: How a run's savings baseline was chosen; the receipt's ``baseline_source``.
BaselineSelectionCase = Literal[
    "session_model", "overlay", "store", "most_used", "fixed_default"
]


def _configured(config: object) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(config, dict):
        return None
    pricing_config = config.get("pricing")
    if not isinstance(pricing_config, dict):
        return None
    candidate = pricing_config.get("baseline_model")
    if isinstance(candidate, str) and candidate.strip():
        return candidate.strip()
    return None


def _most_used(history: Mapping[str, int] | None) -> str | None:
    counts = {
        model.strip(): count
        for model, count in (history or {}).items()
        if isinstance(model, str) and model.strip() and count >= 1
    }
    if not counts:
        return None
    return min(counts, key=lambda model: (-counts[model], model))


def configured_or_most_used(
    overlay: object, store: object, history: Mapping[str, int] | None
) -> tuple[str, BaselineSelectionCase] | None:
    """The baseline and its case, or None when the fixed default applies."""
    for config, case in ((overlay, "overlay"), (store, "store")):
        model = _configured(config)
        if model is not None:
            return model, "overlay" if case == "overlay" else "store"
    most_used = _most_used(history)
    return (most_used, "most_used") if most_used is not None else None
```

```python
"""The caller's protocol table: which protocols exist and which node declares which."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Self

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, model_validator

from omnimarket.models.binding_conformance.model_binding_node_row import (
    ModelBindingNodeRow,
)

    ModelBindingProtocol,

class ModelBindingProtocolTable(BaseModel):
    """Data supplied by the caller; the node holds no row and no protocol of its own."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    protocols: tuple[ModelBindingProtocol, ...]
    rows: tuple[ModelBindingNodeRow, ...]

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _consistent(self) -> Self:
        codes = [p.code for p in self.protocols]
        refs = [p.protocol for p in self.protocols]
        if len(set(codes)) != len(codes):
            raise ValueError("a protocol code appears twice in the table")
        if len(set(refs)) != len(refs):
            raise ValueError("a protocol import path appears twice in the table")
        nodes = [r.node for r in self.rows]
        if len(set(nodes)) != len(nodes):
            raise ValueError("a node has two rows in the table")
        for row in self.rows:
            unknown = sorted(set(row.protocols) - set(codes))
            if unknown:
                raise ValueError(f"row of {row.node} names unknown protocol {unknown}")
            if len(set(row.protocols)) != len(row.protocols):
                raise ValueError(f"row of {row.node} repeats a protocol")
        return self
```

```python
                )
```

```python
            )
```

```python
        if self.kind == "kafka":

                raise ValueError("a kafka broker needs bootstrap_servers")

            for value in (
                self.lane,
                self.bootstrap_servers,
                self.security_protocol,
                self.sasl_mechanism,
                self.sasl_username,
                self.sasl_password,
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "an inmemory bus has no broker, so it carries no transport"
            )
        return self

    def client_security(self) -> dict[str, str]:

            config["sasl.username"] = self.sasl_username
```

```python
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""A lane's live application containers against the budget declared for it (one-runtime plan, task T2).

Nothing compared a lane's running application containers with a declared count, so a second container appeared unseen
until someone found it in a container dashboard. The handler reads one host's recorded container listing, attributes
each running container to a lane by its compose project, drops infrastructure the declaration names, and judges the
count against that lane's declared budget.

Over budget is FAIL. A host that was not read is UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN fails too; there is no warning status. Each
failing lane raises one alarm keyed ``lane-budget:<host>:<lane>``, and ``upsert_alarms`` rewrites the row under that
key, so a rerun never adds a second row.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass

from omnimarket.models.model_lane_container_budget import (
    ModelLaneContainerBudgetAlarm,
    ModelLaneContainerBudgetDeclaration,
    ModelLaneContainerBudgetLane,
    ModelLaneContainerBudgetRequest,
    ModelLaneContainerBudgetVerdict,
)

COMPOSE_PROJECT_LABEL = "com.docker.compose.project"
RUNNING_STATE = "running"
UNDECLARED_LANE = "undeclared"


def alarm_key(host: str, lane: str) -> str:
    return f"lane-budget:{host}:{lane}"


def parse_labels(raw: object) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Labels as the listing carries them: a mapping, or the CLI's comma-joined ``k=v`` string.

    A label value may itself contain commas (a list of compose files), so a segment with no ``=`` continues the
    value before it.
    """
    if isinstance(raw, Mapping):
        return {str(k): str(v) for k, v in raw.items()}
    labels: dict[str, str] = {}
    current: str | None = None
    for segment in str(raw or "").split(","):
        if "=" in segment:
            key, value = segment.split("=", 1)
            current = key.strip()
            labels[current] = value.strip()
        elif current is not None and segment:
            labels[current] = f"{labels[current]},{segment}"
    return labels


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Container:
    name: str
    state: str
    project: str


def parse_listing(listing: str) -> tuple[_Container, ...] | str:
    """The listing's containers, or the reason it cannot be read."""
    containers: list[_Container] = []
    for number, line in enumerate(listing.splitlines(), start=1):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            row = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return f"listing line {number} is not JSON"
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            return f"listing line {number} is not a JSON object"
        name = str(row.get("Names") or "").lstrip("/").strip()
        if not name:
            return f"listing line {number} names no container"
        labels = parse_labels(row.get("Labels"))
        containers.append(
            _Container(
                name=name,
                state=str(row.get("State") or ""),
                project=labels.get(COMPOSE_PROJECT_LABEL, ""),
            )
        )
    if not containers:
        return "the container listing is empty"
    return tuple(containers)


def _unknown(
    declaration: ModelLaneContainerBudgetDeclaration, reason: str
) -> ModelLaneContainerBudgetLane:
    return ModelLaneContainerBudgetLane(
        host=declaration.host,
        lane=declaration.lane,
        status="UNKNOWN",
        observed=None,
        budget=declaration.application_container_budget,
        containers=(),
        detail=f"UNKNOWN, which fails: {reason}",
        target=declaration.application_container_target,
    )


def _judge(
    declaration: ModelLaneContainerBudgetDeclaration,
    containers: tuple[_Container, ...],
) -> ModelLaneContainerBudgetLane:
    names = tuple(
        sorted(
            c.name
            for c in containers
            if c.project == declaration.compose_project
            and c.state == RUNNING_STATE
            and not any(m in c.name for m in declaration.infrastructure_markers)
        )
    )
    budget = declaration.application_container_budget
    return ModelLaneContainerBudgetLane(
        host=declaration.host,
        lane=declaration.lane,
        status="FAIL" if len(names) > budget else "PASS",
        observed=len(names),
        budget=budget,
        containers=names,
        detail=f"{len(names)} application containers running, budget {budget}",
        target=declaration.application_container_target,
        slack=max(budget - len(names), 0),
    )


def _alarm(lane: ModelLaneContainerBudgetLane) -> ModelLaneContainerBudgetAlarm:
    return ModelLaneContainerBudgetAlarm(
        key=alarm_key(lane.host, lane.lane),
        host=lane.host,
        lane=lane.lane,
        status="FAIL" if lane.status == "FAIL" else "UNKNOWN",
        observed=lane.observed,
        budget=lane.budget,
        containers=lane.containers,
        detail=lane.detail,
    )


class HandlerLaneContainerBudget:
    def handle(
        self, request: ModelLaneContainerBudgetRequest
    ) -> ModelLaneContainerBudgetVerdict:
        declarations = tuple(d for d in request.declarations if d.host == request.host)
        if not declarations:
            alarm = ModelLaneContainerBudgetAlarm(
                key=alarm_key(request.host, UNDECLARED_LANE),
                host=request.host,
                lane=UNDECLARED_LANE,
                status="UNKNOWN",
                observed=None,
                budget=None,
                containers=(),
                detail=f"UNKNOWN, which fails: no application container budget is declared for host {request.host}",
            )
            return ModelLaneContainerBudgetVerdict(
                host=request.host,
                status="UNKNOWN",
                failed=True,
                lanes=(),
                alarms=(alarm,),
            )
        listing = (
            f"the host read failed: {request.read_error}"
            if request.read_error
            else parse_listing(request.docker_ps)
        )
        lanes = tuple(
            _unknown(d, listing) if isinstance(listing, str) else _judge(d, listing)
            for d in sorted(declarations, key=lambda d: d.lane)
        )
        statuses = {lane.status for lane in lanes}
        status = (
            "FAIL"
            if "FAIL" in statuses
            else "UNKNOWN"
            if "UNKNOWN" in statuses
            else "PASS"
        )
        return ModelLaneContainerBudgetVerdict(
            host=request.host,
            status=status,
            failed=status != "PASS",
            lanes=lanes,
            alarms=tuple(_alarm(lane) for lane in lanes if lane.status != "PASS"),
        )

    def closing_check(
        self, verdict: ModelLaneContainerBudgetVerdict
    ) -> tuple[ModelLaneContainerBudgetLane, ...]:
        """The plan's closing comparison of each lane's budget with its live count.

        An empty result means every budget equals its live count.
        """
        return tuple(lane for lane in verdict.lanes if lane.slack != 0)

    def upsert_alarms(
        self,
        rows: tuple[ModelLaneContainerBudgetAlarm, ...],
        verdict: ModelLaneContainerBudgetVerdict,
    ) -> tuple[ModelLaneContainerBudgetAlarm, ...]:
        """The alarm rows after this verdict: a row with the same key is replaced, never added beside."""
        keyed = {row.key: row for row in rows}
        keyed.update({alarm.key: alarm for alarm in verdict.alarms})
        return tuple(keyed[key] for key in sorted(keyed))
```
